sentence: This project tests whether a research course and a CRISPR curriculum module at a rural branch campus improve retention in introductory biology.
This project builds tools that teach computer models to make 3-D shapes that are geometrically feasible, physically stable, and topologically correct.
This project builds a testbed that uses robots and AI to help search and rescue teams respond to natural disasters such as fires, earthquakes, and hurricanes.
This project builds a database that models human perception, so samples of data keep the outliers and patterns that analysts need.
This project uses deep learning to help unmanned aerial vehicles with localization, wireless sensing, and secure wireless communications.
This project studies how ions can direct polymers to assemble into organized networks, using an automated platform to test many material combinations.
This project studies how microorganisms survive and function in freshened groundwater beneath the sea floor, using samples from ocean drilling.
